series.name: Smart-UPS C 1000/1500 VA (Tower / Rack-Mount 2U, 120/230 Vac)
series.notes: Line-interactive Smart-UPS C. The LCD prints a single 'System Errors and Message Codes' table with four code families: P.## (output/power stage), b.## (battery), G.## (general/ground) and L.## (lifetime). For Pakistan use the 230 Vac column; G.00 Site Wiring Fault is explicitly '(Applicable for 120 V units only)' and is NOT expected on 230 V installs. G.07 EPO Active is reserved for 2200/3000 VA models only, so it will not appear on 1000/1500 VA units. Codes are case-sensitive as printed ('b.00' lower-case b). Sc.0-Sc.8 are SmartConnect network states, not faults.

meaning.en: The connected load draws more power than the UPS output stage is rated for, so the inverter trips to protect itself.
meaning.ur: Jo load lagi hai wo UPS ki rated capacity se zyada le rahi hai, is liye inverter apni protection ke liye band ho jata hai.

causes.en: Too much equipment on the UPS outlets, or load added after installation.
causes.ur: UPS ke outlets par bohat zyada equipment lagi hai, ya installation ke baad load barha diya gaya.

causes.en: One faulty or shorted load dragging current continuously.
causes.ur: Koi ek kharaab ya short karne wala load lagatar current kheech raha hai.

causes.en: Inverter DC bus or output IGBT degraded with age, tripping below real capacity.
causes.ur: Umra ke saath inverter DC bus ya output IGBT weak ho gaya hai, asli capacity se kam par hi trip kar raha hai.

solutions.en: Read the load percentage on the LCD and compare it with the unit's rated watts.
solutions.ur: LCD par load percentage dekhein aur unit ki rated watts se compare karein.

solutions.en: Unplug non-essential equipment one item at a time until the overload clears.
solutions.ur: Ek-ek karke naami equipment nikaalte jayein jab tak overload na hat jaye.

solutions.en: Measure each load's draw with a clamp meter on the output to find the offending device.
solutions.ur: Output par clamp meter lagakar har load ka current nikaalein taake ghalat device pakda ja sake.

notes.en: Unit will keep trying to restart while the overload is present; unplugging the load is what clears it.
notes.ur: Load mojood hone tak unit restart karta rahega; load nikalne par hi yeh hat jata hai.

source.title: Operation Manual - Smart-UPS C Uninterruptible Power Supply 1000/1500 VA Tower / Rack-Mount 2U, 120 Vac/230 Vac (part su0752c/su0752d)

meaning.en: The inverter output is shorted to line, neutral or earth, so the UPS shuts the output down.
meaning.ur: Inverter output line, neutral ya earth ke saath short ho gaya hai, is liye UPS ne output band kar diya.

causes.en: A connected device has failed with a shorted internal supply.
causes.ur: Kisi connected device ka internal supply short ho kar kharab ho gaya hai.

causes.en: Damaged or pinched output wiring, or a bad outlet/PDU feeding the load.
causes.ur: Output wiring damaged ya pinched hai, ya load ke liye outlet/PDU kharab hai.

causes.en: Output relay or IGBT failed shorted inside the UPS.
causes.ur: UPS ke andar output relay ya IGBT short ho kar kharab ho gaya hai.

solutions.en: Switch the UPS off, unplug the output plug, and disconnect all load before touching wiring.
solutions.ur: UPS off karein, output plug nikaalein, aur wiring chhoone se pehle saara load disconnect kar lein.

solutions.en: Test continuity and insulation of each output branch with a multimeter; expect no continuity to earth.
solutions.ur: Har output branch ki continuity aur insulation multimeter se check karein; earth par continuity nahi honi chahiye.

solutions.en: Reconnect loads one at a time to identify which branch is shorted.
solutions.ur: Load ek-ek karke dobara connect karke dekhein kaunsi branch short hai.

notes.en: Do not re-power with a short still present; it can destroy the inverter stage.
notes.ur: Short mojood hone par dobara power na karein; inverter stage kharab ho sakta hai.

source.title: Operation Manual - Smart-UPS C Uninterruptible Power Supply 1000/1500 VA Tower / Rack-Mount 2U, 120 Vac/230 Vac (part su0752c/su0752d)

meaning.en: The inverter output voltage has risen above the safe window, so the UPS aborts to protect the load.
meaning.ur: Inverter output voltage safe limit se upar chala gaya hai, is liye UPS load bachane ke liye ruk jata hai.

causes.en: Utility input voltage far too high and the boost/AVR stage driven to its limit.
causes.ur: Utility input voltage bohat zyada hai aur boost/AVR stage apni limit tak chala gaya hai.

causes.en: Failed output voltage feedback sensor, so the control loop reads high.
causes.ur: Output voltage feedback sensor kharab hai, is liye control loop voltage zyada parh raha hai.

causes.en: DC bus over-voltage from an over-charging battery string or a failed charger.
causes.ur: Battery string zyada charge hone ya charger kharab hone se DC bus over-voltage ho gaya hai.

solutions.en: Measure the wall outlet with a multimeter; confirm the input is inside the unit's rated window.
solutions.ur: Wall outlet ko multimeter se measure karein; confirm karein input unit ki rating ke andar hai.

solutions.en: Read input and output voltage on the UPS LCD and compare against the LCD readings with a meter.
solutions.ur: UPS LCD par input aur output voltage dekhein aur multimeter reading se compare karein.

solutions.en: Turn the UPS off and have the battery string and charger checked before restarting.
solutions.ur: UPS band karein aur restart se pehle battery string aur charger check karwa lein.

notes.en: On 230 V installs, a long or undersized mains feed from the DB is the usual reason input is high.
notes.ur: 230 V par DB se aane wala lamba ya chhota feeder aksar input high hone ki wajah hota hai.

source.title: Operation Manual - Smart-UPS C Uninterruptible Power Supply 1000/1500 VA Tower / Rack-Mount 2U, 120 Vac/230 Vac (part su0752c/su0752d)

meaning.en: The DC offset between the inverter's half-bridge legs is outside the allowed window, so the UPS shuts down.
meaning.ur: Inverter ke dono half-bridge legs ke darmiyan DC imbalance allowed limit se bahar hai, is liye UPS band ho jata hai.

causes.en: A weak, sulphated or out-of-balance battery string feeding the DC link.
causes.ur: Weak, sulphated ya unbalanced battery string DC link ko feed kar rahi hai.

causes.en: One inverter leg (IGBT/module) leaking, so its half bus sags differently.
causes.ur: Inverter ka ek leg (IGBT/module) leak kar raha hai, is liye uska half bus alag girta hai.

causes.en: Blown fusible in the DC link or a DC bus capacitor leaking.
causes.ur: DC link ka fuse uth gaya ya DC bus capacitor leak kar raha hai.

solutions.en: Power the UPS off and disconnect the battery before opening the unit.
solutions.ur: Unit kholne se pehle UPS off karein aur battery disconnect kar lein.

solutions.en: Measure each battery cell in series with a DC meter; every cell should read within about 0.2 V of its neighbours.
solutions.ur: Har battery cell ko DC meter se series mein measure karein; har cell apne padosi se lagbhag 0.2 V ke andar hona chahiye.

solutions.en: Have the inverter legs, DC link fuse and bus capacitors tested at component level by a service centre.
solutions.ur: Inverter legs, DC link fuse aur bus capacitors service centre par component level par test karwa lein.

notes.en: P.03 and P.04 frequently appear together on the same ageing battery/cooling problem.
notes.ur: P.03 aur P.04 aksar ek hi battery ya cooling ki kharabi par saath aate hain.

source.title: Operation Manual - Smart-UPS C Uninterruptible Power Supply 1000/1500 VA Tower / Rack-Mount 2U, 120 Vac/230 Vac (part su0752c/su0752d)

meaning.en: The UPS internal temperature sensor has gone above the shutdown limit, so the unit protects itself by cutting out.
meaning.ur: UPS ka internal temperature sensor shutdown limit se upar chala gaya hai, is liye unit apni protection ke liye band ho jata hai.

causes.en: Blocked air intake or a dusty/clogged fan, so the fan cannot move air.
causes.ur: Air intake block hai ya fan dusty/clogged hai, is liye fan hawa nahi chala raha.

causes.en: Fan failed or its supply/disconnect has come loose.
causes.ur: Fan kharab ho gaya hai ya uska connector nikal gaya hai.

causes.en: Rack or cupboard too enclosed and ambient temperature above the rated limit.
causes.ur: Rack ya cabinet bohat band hai aur ambient temperature rated limit se upar hai.

solutions.en: Switch off, unplug from mains, and disconnect the battery before opening the unit or clearing dust.
solutions.ur: Unit kholne ya saaf karne se pehle off karein, mains se nikaalein aur battery disconnect kar lein.

solutions.en: Clear dust from the intake and exhaust grilles and the fan with compressed air; confirm the fan spins freely by hand.
solutions.ur: Intake aur exhaust grilles aur fan ko compressed air se saaf karein; haath se ghoorne par fan khul ke ghoomne ka muwadaqa karein.

solutions.en: Check fan spin-up on DC: with the battery connected and the UPS off, the fan should start within a second of power-up.
solutions.ur: Fan ka DC par chalna check karein: battery connect kar ke UPS off hone par power dete hi fan 1 second ke andar chalna shuru kare.

solutions.en: Move the UPS out of a closed cabinet and keep at least the clearance printed in the manual.
solutions.ur: UPS ko band cabinet se nikaalein aur manual mein likhi hui minimum clearance rakhein.

notes.en: APC's own wording for a related symptom: 'Ensure that ambient temperature is within limits. Ensure that adequate clearance is maintained.'
notes.ur: APC ka usi masle ke liye alfaz: 'Ambient temperature limit ke andar ho, aur clearance poori ho.'

source.title: Operation Manual - Smart-UPS C Uninterruptible Power Supply 1000/1500 VA Tower / Rack-Mount 2U, 120 Vac/230 Vac (part su0752c/su0752d)

meaning.en: The relay that stops utility power reaching the load while the UPS is on battery is not in the commanded state.
meaning.ur: Woh relay jo battery chalte waqt utility ko load tak nahi pohanchne deta, apni commanded position mein nahi hai.

causes.en: Backfeed relay contacts welded together from an arc fault.
causes.ur: Arc fault ki wajah se backfeed relay ke contacts jalm (weld) gaye hain.

causes.en: Backfeed relay coil open or its drive circuit failed, so it never pulls in.
causes.ur: Backfeed relay ki coil khuli hai ya drive circuit kharab hai, is liye relay kabhi attract nahi hota.

causes.en: Relay mechanically stuck due to foreign matter or internal mechanism wear.
causes.ur: Relay ke andar ghusi cheez ya wearing ki wajah se mechanically atak gaya hai.

solutions.en: Remove mains and battery before opening the UPS, then note the backfeed relay position with the unit unpowered.
solutions.ur: UPS kholne se pehle mains aur battery nikaalein, phir unpowered state mein relay ki position note karein.

solutions.en: Check relay coil continuity/resistance with an ohmmeter across the coil pins after removing the relay from circuit.
solutions.ur: Relay circuit se nikaal kar ohmmeter se coil ki continuity/resistance check karein.

solutions.en: Look for darkened or pitted contact surfaces; pitted or welded contacts cannot be cleaned back into spec and the relay must be replaced.
solutions.ur: Contact surfaces par kaale ya ghis ke nishaan dekhein; ghisay ya jalmay contact theek nahi ho sakte aur relay badalna zaroori hai.

notes.en: Never bridge or defeat the backfeed relay - it is the isolation that keeps the load safe.
notes.ur: Backfeed relay ko kabhi bypass ya jaam na karein - yahi load ko mehfooz rakhta hai.

source.title: Operation Manual - Smart-UPS C Uninterruptible Power Supply 1000/1500 VA Tower / Rack-Mount 2U, 120 Vac/230 Vac (part su0752c/su0752d)

meaning.en: The relay that switches the tap on the boost transformer is not moving as commanded, so line regulation has failed.
meaning.ur: Boost transformer ke tap ko switch karne wala relay apni command ke mutabiq nahi chal raha, is liye line regulation kharab hai.

causes.en: AVR relay contacts welded or pitted, so the tap never changes.
causes.ur: AVR relay ke contacts jalm ya ghis chuke hain, is liye tap kabhi nahi badalta.

causes.en: AVR relay drive transistor or its coil supply has failed.
causes.ur: AVR relay ka drive transistor ya uski coil supply kharab ho gayi hai.

causes.en: Actuator or transformer tap mechanism jammed by dust or wear.
causes.ur: Actuator ya transformer ka tap mechanism dust ya wearing ki wajah se jam ho gaya hai.

solutions.en: Isolate mains and battery first, then exercise the AVR relay by hand to check for free movement.
solutions.ur: Pehle mains aur battery isolate karein, phir AVR relay ko haath se chala kar aazadi dekh lein.

solutions.en: Measure coil resistance and the drive transistor's collector-emitter junction as a short test.
solutions.ur: Coil resistance aur drive transistor ka collector-emitter junction short test se check karein.

solutions.en: Clean the relay and relay bay with compressed air and a contact-cleaner spray, then re-seat the connector.
solutions.ur: Relay aur relay bay ko compressed air aur contact-cleaner spray se saaf karein, phir connector dobara baitha dein.

notes.en: Until the AVR relay is fixed the unit will still pass power but without boost regulation, so loads see sags.
notes.ur: AVR relay theek hone tak unit power dega magar boost regulation ke baghair, is liye load ko sags jhelne padenge.

source.title: Operation Manual - Smart-UPS C Uninterruptible Power Supply 1000/1500 VA Tower / Rack-Mount 2U, 120 Vac/230 Vac (part su0752c/su0752d)

meaning.en: The relay that connects the inverter output to the load has not switched or cannot hold, so output is lost or unsafe.
meaning.ur: Woh relay jo inverter output ko load se jorta hai switch nahi hua ya hold nahi kar sakta, is liye output gaya ya unsafe ho gaya.

causes.en: Output relay contacts welded from an inrush or short-circuit event.
causes.ur: Inrush ya short-circuit event se output relay ke contacts jalm gaye hain.

causes.en: Output relay coil open or its driver failed.
causes.ur: Output relay ki coil khuli hai ya driver kharab hai.

causes.en: Transformer secondary or output bus fault dragging excessive current through the relay.
causes.ur: Transformer secondary ya output bus ka fault relay se zyada current kheech raha hai.

solutions.en: Turn the unit off, unplug from mains and disconnect the battery before any inspection.
solutions.ur: Check karne se pehle unit off karein, mains se nikaalein aur battery disconnect kar lein.

solutions.en: With the load unplugged, measure output voltage at the outlets; the relay should switch cleanly on and off.
solutions.ur: Load nikaal kar outlets par output voltage measure karein; relay saaf se on aur off hona chahiye.

solutions.en: Inspect contact faces for welding pitting and check coil resistance; replace the relay if pitted or welded.
solutions.ur: Welding/pitting ke liye contact surfaces dekhein aur coil resistance check karein; pitted ya jalmay relay badal dein.

notes.en: A welded output relay is a stop-production fault - the UPS cannot be trusted to transfer back.
notes.ur: Jalmaya hua output relay production-stopping fault hai - UPS par bharosa nahi kiya ja sakta.

source.title: Operation Manual - Smart-UPS C Uninterruptible Power Supply 1000/1500 VA Tower / Rack-Mount 2U, 120 Vac/230 Vac (part su0752c/su0752d)

meaning.en: The inverter stage has reported an internal error and the UPS has shut the output down.
meaning.ur: Inverter stage ne internal error report kiya hai aur UPS ne output band kar diya hai.

causes.en: Inverter IGBT or module failed short or open, usually after an overload or over-temperature event.
causes.ur: Overload ya over-temperature ke baad inverter IGBT ya module short ya khul ho kar kharab hua hai.

causes.en: Inverter drive board component failure.
causes.ur: Inverter drive board ka koi component kharab ho gaya hai.

causes.en: DC link under-voltage because the battery string is dead or the connector is loose.
causes.ur: Battery string kharab ya connector loose hone se DC link under-voltage ho gaya hai.

solutions.en: Isolate mains and battery, then measure the DC bus voltage with a meter to confirm the link is being charged.
solutions.ur: Mains aur battery isolate karein, phir meter se DC bus voltage nikaalein taake confirm ho ke link charge ho raha hai.

solutions.en: Check battery string voltage and each cell; recharge for at least 4 hours and re-run self-test before condemning the inverter.
solutions.ur: Battery string voltage aur har cell check karein; inverter kharab kehne se pehle kam az kam 4 ghante charge karein aur self-test chalayein.

solutions.en: Have the inverter IGBTs and drive board tested at component level; if the stage is dead the board or module must be replaced, not the batteries alone.
solutions.ur: Inverter IGBT aur drive board component level par test karwa lein; stage kharab ho to board ya module badalna hoga, sirf battery nahi.

notes.en: APC's manual for an internal fault reads: 'Do not attempt to use the UPS. Contact the Customer Care Center immediately.'
notes.ur: APC manual mein internal fault ke liye likha hai: 'UPS istemaal na karein, foran Customer Care Center se rabta karein.'

source.title: Operation Manual - Smart-UPS C Uninterruptible Power Supply 1000/1500 VA Tower / Rack-Mount 2U, 120 Vac/230 Vac (part su0752c/su0752d)

meaning.en: The relay that routes load through the efficiency bypass in Green Mode has not switched as commanded.
meaning.ur: Green Mode mein load ko efficiency bypass se chalane wala relay apni command ke mutabiq switch nahi hua.

causes.en: Green relay contacts welded or pitted from repeated bypass transfers.
causes.ur: Baar baar bypass transfer se Green relay ke contacts jalm ya ghis chuke hain.

causes.en: Green relay coil open or its drive circuit failed.
causes.ur: Green relay ki coil khuli hai ya uska drive circuit kharab ho gaya hai.

causes.en: Green Mode misconfigured for a load that cannot tolerate bypass transfer.
causes.ur: Green Mode aise load ke liye set hai jo bypass transfer bardasht nahi kar sakta.

solutions.en: Isolate mains and battery, then exercise the relay mechanism by hand to confirm it is free and not welded.
solutions.ur: Mains aur battery isolate karein, phir relay mechanism ko haath se chala kar confirm karein ke azaad hai aur jalm nahi hua.

solutions.en: Measure the relay coil resistance and check the drive output at the coil pins with the unit powered safely.
solutions.ur: Relay coil ki resistance nikaalein aur unit ko mehfooz tareeqe se power par rakh kar coil pins par drive output check karein.

solutions.en: Disable Green Mode in the configuration as a test: if P.17 stops, the relay or its drive circuit is confirmed.
solutions.ur: Test ke liye configuration mein Green Mode band kar dein: agar P.17 ruk jaye to relay ya uska drive circuit confirm ho gaya.

solutions.en: If the relay is welded or pitted, replace it - a welded bypass relay cannot be cleaned back into spec.
solutions.ur: Agar relay jalm ya pitted hai to badal dein - jalmaya bypass relay theek nahi ho sakta.

notes.en: Green Mode passes utility power straight to the load through this relay when input is within set limits; that is why its failure matters.
notes.ur: Green Mode mein input set limits ke andar ho to yeh relay utility seedha load tak bhejta hai; is liye iski kharabi ahem hai.

source.title: Operation Manual - Smart-UPS C Uninterruptible Power Supply 1000/1500 VA Tower / Rack-Mount 2U, 120 Vac/230 Vac (part su0752c/su0752d)

meaning.en: The UPS has lost the battery pack, so there is no backup and the runtime is zero.
meaning.ur: UPS ka battery pack disconnect ho gaya hai, is liye backup nahi hai aur runtime zero hai.

causes.en: Battery connector unplugged or not fully seated.
causes.ur: Battery connector nikal gaya hai ya poora baith nahi hai.

causes.en: Internal battery fuse or breaker tripped or blown.
causes.ur: Internal battery fuse ya breaker trip ya uth chuka hai.

causes.en: Battery string aged, deep-discharged and no longer accepted by the charger.
causes.ur: Battery string purani ho kar deep-discharge ho chuki hai aur charger use qubool nahi karta.

solutions.en: Switch the UPS off, unplug mains, then open the battery bay and reseat the battery connector firmly.
solutions.ur: UPS off karein, mains se nikaalein, phir battery bay khol kar battery connector mazbooti se baitha dein.

solutions.en: Check the internal battery fuse/breaker with an ohmmeter; replace it with the same rating if open.
solutions.ur: Ohmmeter se internal battery fuse/breaker check karein; khuli ho to usi rating se badal dein.

solutions.en: Measure the battery string DC voltage; a healthy Smart-UPS C string reads roughly 2 x 12 V per battery pack at float.
solutions.ur: Battery string ka DC voltage nikaalein; healthy string float par lagbhag 2 x 12 V per battery pack deta hai.

solutions.en: Allow 4 hours of charging then run self-test; if the code returns, replace the battery pack.
solutions.ur: 4 ghante charge karne ke baad self-test chalayein; code dobara aaye to battery pack badal dein.

notes.en: APC's Easy UPS equivalent wording: 'Battery is not connected. Connect battery to the UPS.'
notes.ur: APC ke Easy UPS mein isi ka alfaz: 'Battery connected nahi hai. Battery UPS se connect karein.'

source.title: Operation Manual - Smart-UPS C Uninterruptible Power Supply 1000/1500 VA Tower / Rack-Mount 2U, 120 Vac/230 Vac (part su0752c/su0752d)

meaning.en: Battery pack voltage has climbed above the safe ceiling, so the charger has shut down to protect the cells.
meaning.ur: Battery pack voltage safe ceiling se upar chala gaya hai, is liye charger ne cells bachane ke liye band kar diya.

causes.en: Charger output failed high or the charge voltage setting is wrong for the pack.
causes.ur: Charger output high par kharab ho gaya hai ya charge voltage setting pack ke liye ghalat hai.

causes.en: Wrong battery type fitted - a higher-capacity pack charged at a voltage above its spec.
causes.ur: Ghalat battery type lagi hai - zyada capacity wala pack apni spec se upar voltage par charge ho raha hai.

causes.en: Ambient temperature high inside the cabinet with no temperature compensation on the charger.
causes.ur: Cabinet ke andar ambient temperature zyada hai aur charger par temperature compensation nahi hai.

solutions.en: Isolate mains and battery, then measure each cell with a DC voltmeter; cells should sit near 13.5-13.8 V at float.
solutions.ur: Mains aur battery isolate karein, phir har cell ko DC voltmeter se nikaalein; float par cells 13.5-13.8 V ke qareeb hone chahiye.

solutions.en: Confirm the fitted battery matches the type/spec printed in the manual and on the battery label.
solutions.ur: Lagi hui battery ka type aur spec manual aur battery ke label se match karein.

solutions.en: Check charger output voltage at the battery terminals with the battery connected; out-of-spec output means the charger board is faulty.
solutions.ur: Battery connect kar ke charger ki output voltage battery terminals par nikaalein; output spec se bahar ho to charger board kharab hai.

solutions.en: If cells are swollen, hot or leaking, stop using the pack and dispose of it safely - do not recharge.
solutions.ur: Agar cells phool gaye, garam ya leaking hain to pack istemaal band karein aur mehfooz tareeqe se fenk dein - dobara charge na karein.

notes.en: Over-charge is a battery-safety fault, not a nuisance alarm. Treat as danger.
notes.ur: Over-charge battery safety ka masla hai, chhoti si ghabrahat nahi. Isay khatarnaq samajhein.

source.title: Operation Manual - Smart-UPS C Uninterruptible Power Supply 1000/1500 VA Tower / Rack-Mount 2U, 120 Vac/230 Vac (part su0752c/su0752d)

meaning.en: The battery failed the self-test, so its capacity is no longer able to carry the load and it must be replaced.
meaning.ur: Battery self-test mein fail ho gayi hai, is liye uski capacity ab load uthane ke qabil nahi aur badalni chahiye.

causes.en: Battery aged past 3-5 years, which is normal service life for these packs.
causes.ur: Battery 3-5 saal se ooper ho gayi hai, jo in packs ki normal service life hai.

causes.en: Battery repeatedly deep-discharged by long outages or frequent switching.
causes.ur: Lambi outages ya baar baar on/off ki wajah se battery baar baar deep-discharge hui.

causes.en: Battery operated at high cabinet temperature, which shortens life sharply.
causes.ur: Battery cabinet ki high temperature par chalti rahi hai, jis se umra bohat kam ho jati hai.

solutions.en: Confirm it is not a false alarm: leave the UPS on mains for at least 4 hours to full charge, then run a self-test.
solutions.ur: Pehle confirm karein ke yeh ghalat alarm nahi: UPS ko mains par kam az kam 4 ghante lagayein taake poori charge ho, phir self-test chalayein.

solutions.en: Measure the battery string DC voltage and confirm the connector is seated; a loose connector mimics a bad battery.
solutions.ur: Battery string ka DC voltage nikaalein aur connector baitha hua check karein; loose connector kharab battery jaisa lagta hai.

solutions.en: Replace the battery pack with the same number and type APC specifies, then re-run self-test to clear the code.
solutions.ur: Battery pack APC ki batay hui same number aur type se badal dein, phir self-test chala kar code clear karein.

notes.en: APC manual: 'Allow the battery to recharge for at least four hours. Then, perform a self-test. If the problem persists after recharging, replace the battery.'
notes.ur: APC manual: 'Battery ko kam az kam chaar ghante charge karne dein, phir self-test karein. Charge ke baad masla baki rahe to battery badal dein.'

source.title: Operation Manual - Smart-UPS C Uninterruptible Power Supply 1000/1500 VA Tower / Rack-Mount 2U, 120 Vac/230 Vac (part su0752c/su0752d)

meaning.en: The battery pack temperature has reached the critical limit, so the UPS has cut the battery to prevent thermal runaway.
meaning.ur: Battery pack ki temperature critical limit tak pohanch gayi hai, is liye UPS ne thermal runaway rokne ke liye battery band kar di hai.

causes.en: Battery pack overcharged, generating heat faster than it can dissipate.
causes.ur: Battery pack zyada charge ho kar itni garmi bana rahi hai jitni nikal nahi sakti.

causes.en: Cabinet ventilation blocked, or the UPS and battery pack crammed in a closed rack with no airflow.
causes.ur: Cabinet ki ventilation band hai, ya UPS aur battery pack aise rack mein rakhe hain jahan hawa nahi chalti.

causes.en: One or more cells shorted internally and heating up in isolation.
causes.ur: Ek ya zyada cells andar se short ho kar khud garam ho rahe hain.

solutions.en: Shut the UPS down, unplug mains, disconnect the battery and move the pack to open air before touching it.
solutions.ur: UPS band karein, mains se nikaalein, battery disconnect karein aur chhoone se pehle pack ko khulay hawa mein le jayein.

solutions.en: Measure the pack temperature with an IR thermometer or probe; compare against the battery label's limit.
solutions.ur: Pack ki temperature IR thermometer ya probe se nikaalein; battery label ki limit se compare karein.

solutions.en: Open the cabinet and check the intake/exhaust grilles for dust build-up; clean with compressed air and restore airflow.
solutions.ur: Cabinet khol kar intake/exhaust grilles par dhool check karein; compressed air se saaf karein aur airflow wapas karein.

solutions.en: Measure each cell's voltage and temperature in turn; a single hot cell means replace the pack, not the whole UPS.
solutions.ur: Ek-ek cell ka voltage aur temperature nikaalein; ek bhi garam cell ho to pack badal dein, poora UPS nahi.

notes.en: APC manual on battery over-temperature: 'Power off the UPS, unplug it from the AC input, and disconnect the batteries. Do not operate the UPS until the batteries have been replaced.'
notes.ur: APC manual battery over-temperature ke liye: 'UPS band karein, AC input se nikaalein, aur battery disconnect karein. Batteries badle baghair UPS istemaal na karein.'

source.title: Operation Manual - Smart-UPS C Uninterruptible Power Supply 1000/1500 VA Tower / Rack-Mount 2U, 120 Vac/230 Vac (part su0752c/su0752d)

meaning.en: The charger circuit has faulted, so the battery is not being charged and runtime will collapse.
meaning.ur: Charger circuit mein fault aa gaya hai, is liye battery charge nahi ho rahi aur runtime gir jayegi.

causes.en: Charger board component failure (MOSFET, rectifier or sense resistor).
causes.ur: Charger board ka koi component kharab (MOSFET, rectifier ya sense resistor).

causes.en: Battery or external battery cabinet presenting a short on the charge path.
causes.ur: Battery ya external battery cabinet charge path par short kar raha hai.

causes.en: Fan failure stopping forced cooling of the charger stage.
causes.ur: Fan kharab ho kar charger stage ki forced cooling rok raha hai.

solutions.en: Turn the UPS off, unplug mains and disconnect the battery, then visually and by smell-check the charger area for burnt parts.
solutions.ur: UPS off karein, mains se nikaalein aur battery disconnect karein, phir charger area mein jale hue parts dekh kar smell check karein.

solutions.en: Measure the battery pack's DC resistance/short across its terminals; a near-zero reading means a shorted pack.
solutions.ur: Battery pack ke terminals par DC resistance/short nikaalein; zero ke qareeb reading matlab shorted pack.

solutions.en: Check the charger fan runs when the UPS is powered from battery; a stopped fan points straight at overheating.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke UPS battery se chalte waqt charger fan chalta hai; fan ruka ho to seedha overheating ki taraf ishara hai.

solutions.en: Run a full charge then self-test; if the charger still reports error the charger board must be serviced or replaced.
solutions.ur: Poori charge karein phir self-test chalayein; charger phir bhi error de to charger board service ya tabdeeli zaroori hai.

notes.en: SE's Easy UPS equivalent (CH9) remedy: verify no short at the battery terminal, then do a manual restart off output and mains.
notes.ur: SE ke Easy UPS mein isi masle (CH9) ka hal: battery terminal par short check karein, phir output aur mains off karke manual restart karein.

source.title: Operation Manual - Smart-UPS C Uninterruptible Power Supply 1000/1500 VA Tower / Rack-Mount 2U, 120 Vac/230 Vac (part su0752c/su0752d)

meaning.en: The UPS has lost the battery temperature sensor reading, so it cannot manage charging safely.
meaning.ur: UPS ka battery temperature sensor ka reading chala gaya hai, is liye charging ko mehfooz tareeqe se control nahi kar sakta.

causes.en: Sensor module unplugged or its ribbon/pin connector pushed off the board.
causes.ur: Sensor module plug nikal gaya hai ya uska ribbon/pin connector board se hat gaya hai.

causes.en: Sensor thermistor open or short inside the battery cabinet.
causes.ur: Sensor ka thermistor battery cabinet ke andar khul gaya ya short ho gaya hai.

causes.en: Sense wiring harness chafed or pinched during a battery replacement.
causes.ur: Sense wiring harness battery badalne waqt ragis ya nichal gaya hai.

solutions.en: Isolate mains and battery, then reseat the battery temperature sensor connector at the board and at the battery cabinet.
solutions.ur: Mains aur battery isolate karein, phir sensor connector board aur battery cabinet dono par mazbooti se baitha dein.

solutions.en: Measure sensor resistance across its two pins with an ohmmeter; it should read a smooth value, not open or zero.
solutions.ur: Ohmmeter se sensor ke do pins par resistance nikaalein; yeh smooth value de, khuli ya zero na ho.

solutions.en: Trace the harness for a break near the cabinet hinge or a battery tray edge; repair with heat-shrink and re-route the cable.
solutions.ur: Harness mein cabinet ke hinge ya battery tray ke kinare ke paas toota hua hissa dekhein; heat-shrink se repair karke cable dobara layein.

solutions.en: Charge normally once the sensor reads again and re-run self-test to clear the code.
solutions.ur: Sensor dobara read karne ke baad normal charge karein aur self-test chala kar code clear karein.

notes.en: Without a working sensor the charger runs on a fixed temperature, so do not leave the unit charging unattended long-term.
notes.ur: Sensor kharab hone par charger aik hi temperature par chalta hai, is liye unit ko lambe arse tak bina nazar ke charge na chhodein.

source.title: Operation Manual - Smart-UPS C Uninterruptible Power Supply 1000/1500 VA Tower / Rack-Mount 2U, 120 Vac/230 Vac (part su0752c/su0752d)

meaning.en: The battery pack is running above its temperature limit; the indicator warns before the critical cut-off at b.03.
meaning.ur: Battery pack apni temperature limit se upar chal raha hai; b.03 ke critical cut-off se pehle yeh indicator ehtiyat karata hai.

causes.en: Cabinet poorly ventilated and room temperature high, typical of Pakistani summers.
causes.ur: Cabinet ki ventilation kam aur room temperature zyada hai - Pakistani garmi mein aam masla.

causes.en: Dust-clogged fans so the UPS cannot move air over the pack.
causes.ur: Fan dhool se block hain, is liye UPS battery par se hawa nahi nikal pata.

causes.en: Battery pack mounted tight against the UPS chassis or another hot unit.
causes.ur: Battery pack UPS chassis ya kisi garam unit se bilkul chipak kar fit ki gayi hai.

solutions.en: Measure room temperature and the pack temperature with a probe; confirm both are within the battery label limits.
solutions.ur: Room temperature aur pack temperature probe se nikaalein; dono battery label ki limit ke andar hain ya nahi confirm karein.

solutions.en: Clean every fan and grille with compressed air and confirm the UPS fan actually spins with the unit powered.
solutions.ur: Har fan aur grille ko compressed air se saaf karein aur unit power par hone par fan sach mein ghoomta hai ya nahi confirm karein.

solutions.en: Open up the cabinet for cross-ventilation and add a small exhaust fan if the site is a closed equipment room.
solutions.ur: Cabinet ko cross-ventilation ke liye kholein aur agar site band equipment room hai to chhota exhaust fan lagayein.

notes.en: b.07 is the warning tier of the same over-temperature family that ends at b.03 - act on it before it escalates.
notes.ur: b.07 usi over-temperature family ki warning hai jo b.03 par khatam hoti hai - badhne se pehle hal kar lein.

source.title: Operation Manual - Smart-UPS C Uninterruptible Power Supply 1000/1500 VA Tower / Rack-Mount 2U, 120 Vac/230 Vac (part su0752c/su0752d)

meaning.en: The battery voltage sensing circuit has faulted, so the UPS cannot judge the state of charge correctly.
meaning.ur: Battery voltage sensing circuit kharab ho gaya hai, is liye UPS battery ki charge state theek se nahi dekh sakta.

causes.en: Voltage sense wire disconnected, broken or corroded at the battery terminal.
causes.ur: Battery terminal par voltage sense wire disconnect, toota ya zang lagay hua hai.

causes.en: Sense divider resistor or op-amp on the control board failed.
causes.ur: Control board ka sense divider resistor ya op-amp kharab ho gaya hai.

causes.en: Sensing line picking up noise or earth leakage from a badly earthed chassis.
causes.ur: Sensing line mein noise ya khami se grounding se earth leakage aa raha hai.

solutions.en: Isolate mains and battery, then compare the LCD battery voltage against a direct DC meter reading at the battery terminals.
solutions.ur: Mains aur battery isolate karein, phir LCD ka battery voltage seedhe battery terminals par DC meter se reading se compare karein.

solutions.en: Clean battery terminals and re-tighten them; corrosion on the terminal is a common cause of bad sensing.
solutions.ur: Battery terminals saaf karein aur dobara kasshein; terminals par zang aksar kharab sensing ki wajah hota hai.

solutions.en: Check the sense wire for continuity end to end with an ohmmeter and repair the break.
solutions.ur: Sense wire ki aik se doosri taraf continuity ohmmeter se check kar ke toota hua hissa repair karein.

solutions.en: Verify chassis earth continuity; a floating earth on the UPS body will upset the sensing reference.
solutions.ur: Chassis earth continuity verify karein; body ka earth adhoora hone par sensing reference bigad jata hai.

notes.en: A wrong battery voltage reading on the LCD is the quickest field check for this code.
notes.ur: LCD par battery voltage ki ghalat reading is code ka sab se tez field check hai.

source.title: Operation Manual - Smart-UPS C Uninterruptible Power Supply 1000/1500 VA Tower / Rack-Mount 2U, 120 Vac/230 Vac (part su0752c/su0752d)

meaning.en: The UPS has measured a wiring defect in the supply: missing earth, hot-neutral reversal or an overloaded neutral.
meaning.ur: UPS ne supply wiring mein koi khaami paayi hai: earth missing, hot-neutral ulat gaya, ya neutral par bohat load.

causes.en: Protective earth not connected at the wall outlet or socket.
causes.ur: Wall outlet ya socket par protective earth connect nahi hai.

causes.en: Line and neutral reversed at the outlet (hot-neutral polarity reversal).
causes.ur: Outlet par line aur neutral aapas mein ulat gaye hain (hot-neutral polarity reversal).

causes.en: Neutral conductor overloaded or shared with other high-current loads.
causes.ur: Neutral conductor overloaded hai ya doosre bhaari loads ke saath mushtarka hai.

solutions.en: Do not open or work on a live socket - have a qualified electrician inspect the building wiring.
solutions.ur: Live socket par kaam ya kholna na karein - building wiring kisi qualified electrician se check karwa lein.

solutions.en: Ask the electrician to verify earth continuity and polarity with a socket tester, then confirm earth pin truly bonded to earth.
solutions.ur: Electrician se socket tester se earth continuity aur polarity check karwa lein, aur confirm karein ke earth pin asal mein earth se juri hai.

solutions.en: Have the neutral conductor size and load sharing re-checked, and correct the reversal before re-powering the UPS.
solutions.ur: Neutral conductor ka size aur load sharing dobara check karwa lein, aur UPS dobara power dene se pehle reversal theek karein.

codes.blinkPattern: System Error LED flashes on for 2 seconds then off for 1 second to indicate site wiring fault

notes.en: APC states this check is '(Applicable for 120 V units only)' - a Pakistani 230 V install will not normally show G.00. If it does, treat the wiring as genuinely faulty.
notes.ur: APC kehta hai yeh check '(Sirf 120 V units ke liye)' - Pakistan ke 230 V install par aam tor par G.00 nahi aayega. Aaye to samajhein ke wiring asal mein kharab hai.

source.title: Operation Manual - Smart-UPS C Uninterruptible Power Supply 1000/1500 VA Tower / Rack-Mount 2U, 120 Vac/230 Vac (part su0752c/su0752d)

meaning.en: The non-volatile settings memory failed a read/write check, so calibration or configuration data is unreliable.
meaning.ur: Non-volatile settings memory ka read/write check fail hua hai, is liye calibration ya configuration data bharosemand nahi.

causes.en: Ongoing power loss or brownout writing to the memory repeatedly and corrupting it.
causes.ur: Baar baar bijli chali jaane ya brownout se memory corrupt ho raha hai.

causes.en: Battery removed for long periods so the memory cells discharged flat.
causes.ur: Battery lambe arse ke liye nikalne se memory cells flat ho gaye.

causes.en: EEPROM chip itself failed.
causes.ur: EEPROM chip hi kharab ho gaya hai.

solutions.en: Power off, unplug mains and disconnect the battery before any board work.
solutions.ur: Board par kaam karne se pehle power off karein, mains se nikaalein aur battery disconnect kar lein.

solutions.en: Run the factory-reset / re-setup routine from the manual, which forces a full memory rewrite and recalibration.
solutions.ur: Manual mein di gayi factory-reset / re-setup routine chalayein, jo poori memory dobara likhta aur recalibrate karta hai.

solutions.en: If the code returns after a successful reset, the EEPROM/control board must be replaced - no user-repairable path exists.
solutions.ur: Agar reset ke baad bhi code laut aaye to EEPROM/control board badalna hoga - user ke liye koi hal nahi.

notes.en: Intermittent mains is the root cause worth fixing first; otherwise the new board fails the same way.
notes.ur: Sabse pehle bijli ki aa-jane ki masla theek karein; warna naya board bhi waise hi kharab hoga.

source.title: Operation Manual - Smart-UPS C Uninterruptible Power Supply 1000/1500 VA Tower / Rack-Mount 2U, 120 Vac/230 Vac (part su0752c/su0752d)

meaning.en: The analogue-to-digital converter on the control board has failed, so voltage and current readings are wrong.
meaning.ur: Control board ka analogue-to-digital converter kharab hai, is liye voltage aur current ki readings ghalat hain.

causes.en: ADC chip failed, usually from earlier surge or over-voltage events.
causes.ur: ADC chip kharab, aam tor par pichle surge ya over-voltage ke baad.

causes.en: Control board contaminated or cracked by heat.
causes.ur: Control board par ghusa hua ya garmi se crack hua.

causes.en: Sense divider network feeding the ADC has failed open.
causes.ur: ADC ko chalane wala sense divider network khul chuka hai.

solutions.en: Disconnect mains and battery before opening the unit, and use an anti-static wrist strap when handling the board.
solutions.ur: Unit kholne se pehle mains aur battery disconnect karein, aur board chhoone se pehle anti-static wrist strap lagayein.

solutions.en: Compare every LCD reading (input V, output V, load %, battery V) against a meter's readings; consistent error across all confirms the ADC.
solutions.ur: Har LCD reading (input V, output V, load %, battery V) ko meter se compare karein; sab par aik hi ghalat error ADC kharabi confirm karta hai.

solutions.en: Have the ADC IC and its sense divider tested and replaced at component level; the board is not field-repairable beyond that.
solutions.ur: ADC IC aur uska sense divider component level par test karwa kar badle dein; us se aage board field level par theek nahi hota.

notes.en: Expect all displayed values to be untrustworthy while this code is active.
notes.ur: Is code ke dauran LCD ki saari values par bharosa na karein.

source.title: Operation Manual - Smart-UPS C Uninterruptible Power Supply 1000/1500 VA Tower / Rack-Mount 2U, 120 Vac/230 Vac (part su0752c/su0752d)

meaning.en: The internal auxiliary rail that powers the control electronics has collapsed, so the logic board is running without proper supply.
meaning.ur: Control electronics ko chalane wali andar ki auxiliary rail gir gayi hai, is liye logic board sahi supply ke baghair chal raha hai.

causes.en: Auxiliary SMPS on the logic board failed its switching stage or a rectifier diode.
causes.ur: Logic board ka auxiliary SMPS ka switching stage ya rectifier diode kharab.

causes.en: Logic rail shorted to earth by a failed capacitor, dragging the supply down.
causes.ur: Koi capacitor short ho kar logic rail ko earth se connect kar raha hai aur supply gira raha hai.

causes.en: Harness feeding the logic rail disconnected or a bad solder joint opened.
causes.ur: Logic rail ko chalane wala harness disconnect ya koi solder joint khul gaya hai.

solutions.en: Isolate mains and battery first, then measure the logic rail on the board with a multimeter against the value marked on the board silk-screen.
solutions.ur: Pehle mains aur battery isolate karein, phir board par logic rail ko multimeter se board ki silk-screen par likhi value se compare karein.

solutions.en: Check for a shorted decoupling capacitor on the logic rail by measuring resistance to earth; a very low reading points to the shorted cap.
solutions.ur: Logic rail par earth ke mutabiq resistance nikaal kar decoupling capacitor check karein; bohat kam reading shorted cap ka ishara hai.

solutions.en: Inspect the auxiliary supply fuse and the harness connectors; reflow or replace the failed stage on the board.
solutions.ur: Auxiliary supply ka fuse aur harness connectors dekhein; kharab stage ko board par reflow ya badal dein.

notes.en: An internal logic supply failure can also cause random restarts, not just this code.
notes.ur: Logic supply kharabi se sirf yeh code nahi, balki beytarbi restart bhi ho sakte hain.

source.title: Operation Manual - Smart-UPS C Uninterruptible Power Supply 1000/1500 VA Tower / Rack-Mount 2U, 120 Vac/230 Vac (part su0752c/su0752d)

meaning.en: The control boards inside the UPS cannot talk to each other, so the unit loses coordination between power and logic.
meaning.ur: UPS ke andar control boards aapas mein baat nahi kar pa rahe, is liye power aur logic ka coordination khatam ho gaya hai.

causes.en: Ribbon cable or board-to-board harness unplugged or chafed.
causes.ur: Ribbon cable ya board-to-board harness nikal hua ya ragis hua hai.

causes.en: A daughter board failed and is holding the bus low.
causes.ur: Koi daughter board kharab ho kar bus ko low par rok kar baitha hai.

causes.en: Connector pins corroded or bent, so the bus is intermittent.
causes.ur: Connector ke pins zange ya tede hue hain, is liye bus baar baar toot raha hai.

solutions.en: Power off, unplug mains, disconnect the battery, and use an anti-static strap before touching board connectors.
solutions.ur: Power off karein, mains se nikaalein, battery disconnect karein, aur board connector chhoone se pehle anti-static strap lagayein.

solutions.en: Reseat every board-to-board ribbon and connector firmly, then inspect the cable for cuts along its routing.
solutions.ur: Har board-to-board ribbon aur connector mazbooti se dobara baitha dein, phir cable mein tute hue hisse dekhein.

solutions.en: With the boards powered but safe to probe, scope or meter the communication bus for a stuck-low line and trace it to the board holding it.
solutions.ur: Boards power par hone ke baad, communication bus ko scope ya meter se check karein ke kaunsi line low par atki hai aur us board tak pohonchein.

solutions.en: If one board is proven faulty, replace that board; the bus itself does not normally fail.
solutions.ur: Agar koi aik board kharab sabit ho to wo board badal dein; bus aam tor par khud nahi kharab hota.

notes.en: A mains surge is the common trigger - check the input earthing and surge protection if this recurs.
notes.ur: Mains surge aam wajah hai - yeh baar baar aaye to input earthing aur surge protection check karein.

source.title: Operation Manual - Smart-UPS C Uninterruptible Power Supply 1000/1500 VA Tower / Rack-Mount 2U, 120 Vac/230 Vac (part su0752c/su0752d)

meaning.en: The user interface button on the front panel is stuck or its switch is faulty, so the unit cannot be commanded normally.
meaning.ur: Front panel ka user interface button atak gaya hai ya uska switch kharab hai, is liye unit ko normal command nahi di ja sakta.

causes.en: Button mechanically jammed by dust, a dropped object or a swollen battery pressing the panel.
causes.ur: Button dhool, giray huay cheez ya phooli battery ke dabayaane se mechanically atak gaya hai.

causes.en: Button switch contact welded closed from repeated pressing.
causes.ur: Baar baar dabane se button switch ka contact jalm kar band ho gaya hai.

causes.en: Front panel flex cable to the control board unplugged or torn.
causes.ur: Control board se jude front panel ke flex cable ka connector nikal gaya ya phat gaya hai.

solutions.en: Power off, unplug mains and disconnect the battery, then press and release the button several times to free it.
solutions.ur: Power off karein, mains se nikaalein aur battery disconnect karein, phir button ko kai baar daba kar chhod kar azaad karein.

solutions.en: Blow dust out of the button gap and clean the switch contact with contact cleaner spray.
solutions.ur: Button ke suraakh mein dhool ki saaf karein aur switch contact ko contact cleaner spray se saaf karein.

solutions.en: With power removed, check the button switch for continuity in and out of position and reseat the panel flex cable.
solutions.ur: Power nikal kar button switch ki continuity pressed aur released position mein check karein aur panel flex cable dobara baitha dein.

solutions.en: If the switch reads permanently closed, replace the switch/button assembly - do not leave a stuck control key.
solutions.ur: Agar switch hamesha band continuity de to switch/button assembly badal dein - atka hua control key chhodein mat.

notes.en: This is a front-panel fault, not a power fault: the UPS keeps protecting the load while it is showing.
notes.ur: Yeh front-panel ka fault hai, power ka nahi: yeh aate hue bhi UPS load ko protect kar raha hota hai.

source.title: Operation Manual - Smart-UPS C Uninterruptible Power Supply 1000/1500 VA Tower / Rack-Mount 2U, 120 Vac/230 Vac (part su0752c/su0752d)

meaning.en: The unit has lost or never received its factory configuration and must be re-initialised before it will run.
meaning.ur: Unit ki factory configuration kho gayi hai ya pehle se set nahi hui, is liye chalne se pehle dobara initialize karna zaroori hai.

causes.en: Settings memory cleared by a G.01 EEPROM event or by removing the battery too long.
causes.ur: G.01 EEPROM event ya battery lambe arse ke liye nikalne se settings memory khaali ho gayi.

causes.en: Control board replaced without the factory programming being written to it.
causes.ur: Control board badalne ke baad factory programming us mein likhi nahi gayi.

causes.en: Firmware and memory data mismatch after a partial firmware update.
causes.ur: Adhoori firmware update ke baad firmware aur memory data mein mismatch ho gaya.

solutions.en: Follow the manual's factory setup / start-up wizard exactly, including any module ID and rating entries.
solutions.ur: Manual ka factory setup / start-up wizard bilkul waise hi follow karein, jis mein module ID aur rating bhi shamil hai.

solutions.en: Ensure the battery is connected and charging before the wizard runs; the wizard writes the memory and needs stable rail power.
solutions.ur: Wizard chalane se pehle battery connect aur charging par zaroor ho; wizard memory likhta hai aur use stable rail power chahiye.

solutions.en: After setup completes, power-cycle the unit and run a self-test to confirm G.06 is cleared.
solutions.ur: Setup mukammal hone ke baad unit ko power-cycle karein aur G.06 mitne ki tasdeq ke liye self-test chalayein.

solutions.en: If setup cannot be completed, the control board needs APC's factory programming file and service access.
solutions.ur: Agar setup mukammal na ho to control board ko APC ka factory programming file aur service access chahiye.

notes.en: G.06 often follows G.01 - the EEPROM event erased the data this code complains about.
notes.ur: G.06 aksar G.01 ke baad aata hai - EEPROM event ne wohi data mita diya jis ki is code ko shikayat hai.

source.title: Operation Manual - Smart-UPS C Uninterruptible Power Supply 1000/1500 VA Tower / Rack-Mount 2U, 120 Vac/230 Vac (part su0752c/su0752d)

meaning.en: The Emergency Power Off input has been triggered, so the UPS has been deliberately shut down.
meaning.ur: Emergency Power Off input trigger ho gaya hai, is liye UPS ko jaan boojh kar band kar diya gaya hai.

causes.en: EPO wall switch pressed by a person, or the EPO contact closed in error.
causes.ur: EPO wall switch kisi ne daba diya, ya ghalat se EPO contact band ho gaya.

causes.en: EPO wiring loop broken or shorted, so the input reads active without anyone pressing it.
causes.ur: EPO wiring loop toota ya short ho gaya, is liye bina kisi dabaye input active parh raha hai.

causes.en: EPO breaker or relay in the circuit stuck in the closed position.
causes.ur: Circuit ka EPO breaker ya relay band position mein atak gaya hai.

solutions.en: Note that G.07 is reserved for 2200 VA and 3000 VA models only, so on a 1000/1500 VA unit it means an installation or wiring problem.
solutions.ur: Yeh yaad rakhein ke G.07 sirf 2200 VA aur 3000 VA models ke liye hai, is liye 1000/1500 VA unit par yeh installation ya wiring ki masla hai.

solutions.en: Check the EPO wall switch and reset it to the released (non-pressed) position.
solutions.ur: EPO wall switch check karein aur usay chhoda (dabaya hua nahin) position par reset karein.

solutions.en: Measure the EPO loop continuity back to the UPS with the loop wiring isolated; the input should read open when released.
solutions.ur: EPO loop wiring alag karke UPS tak continuity nikaalein; chhode jaane par input khuli honi chahiye.

solutions.en: Confirm the UPS returns to normal after the EPO source is cleared; if not, service the EPO input board.
solutions.ur: EPO source theek karne ke baad confirm karein ke UPS normal par aa jaye; warna EPO input board service karwa lein.

notes.en: EPO is a safety device, not a malfunction. If nobody pressed it, treat the loop wiring as the fault.
notes.ur: EPO safety device hai, ghalti nahi. Agar kisi ne nahi dabaya to loop wiring ko hi fault samajhein.

source.title: Operation Manual - Smart-UPS C Uninterruptible Power Supply 1000/1500 VA Tower / Rack-Mount 2U, 120 Vac/230 Vac (part su0752c/su0752d)

meaning.en: The control board firmware does not match the unit's hardware revision, so the unit refuses to run.
meaning.ur: Control board ka firmware unit ke hardware revision se match nahi karta, is liye unit chalne se inkar karta hai.

causes.en: Firmware update interrupted or power lost part-way through writing.
causes.ur: Firmware update dauran-baadan mein ruk gaya ya likhte waqt bijli chali gayi.

causes.en: Control board swapped from another unit, carrying the wrong firmware.
causes.ur: Doosre unit ka control board lagaya gaya, jis par ghalat firmware hai.

causes.en: Firmware corrupted by a brownout while idle in memory.
causes.ur: Brownout ki wajah se memory mein firmware corrupt ho gaya.

solutions.en: Do not cut power during any firmware write; run the update on a fully charged battery and stable mains.
solutions.ur: Firmware likhte waqt bijli na kaatein; update poori charge wali battery aur stable mains par chalayein.

solutions.en: Check the running firmware version and the available version on the About/Firmware menu; if they differ, run the update again from the manual.
solutions.ur: About/Firmware menu se chal raha aur available firmware version compare karein; farq ho to manual ke mutabiq update dobara chalayein.

solutions.en: Confirm the board part number matches the unit part number before flashing anything onto it.
solutions.ur: Kuch bhi flash karne se pehle confirm karein ke board ka part number unit ke part number se match karta hai.

solutions.en: If the unit's version will not load, the control board must be re-flashed by a service centre with the correct image.
solutions.ur: Agar unit ka version load nahi hota to control board ko service centre se sahi image ke saath dobara flash karwa lein.

notes.en: Never flash a board from a different model; this is how boards get bricked.
notes.ur: Doosre model ka board kabhi flash na karein; isi tarah boards puri tarah dead ho jate hain.

source.title: Operation Manual - Smart-UPS C Uninterruptible Power Supply 1000/1500 VA Tower / Rack-Mount 2U, 120 Vac/230 Vac (part su0752c/su0752d)

meaning.en: The inverter's timing reference oscillator has failed, so the unit cannot hold a stable output frequency.
meaning.ur: Inverter ka timing reference oscillator kharab ho gaya hai, is liye unit stable output frequency nahi rakh sakta.

causes.en: Crystal or oscillator module on the control/inverter board failed.
causes.ur: Control ya inverter board ka crystal ya oscillator module kharab ho gaya.

causes.en: Oscillator output stage (buffer/divider) failed after a surge.
causes.ur: Surge ke baad oscillator ka output stage (buffer/divider) kharab ho gaya.

causes.en: Oscillator supply rail not reaching the oscillator because of a decoupling fault.
causes.ur: Decoupling fault ki wajah se oscillator ki supply rail oscillator tak nahi pohanch rahi.

solutions.en: Isolate mains and battery and use an anti-static strap before opening the unit.
solutions.ur: Unit kholne se pehle mains aur battery isolate karein aur anti-static strap lagayein.

solutions.en: Check the output frequency on the LCD and on a multimeter or frequency meter; drift off 50 Hz confirms the oscillator is not holding.
solutions.ur: LCD aur multimeter/frequency meter par output frequency check karein; 50 Hz se hatna confirm karta hai ke oscillator hold nahi kar raha.

solutions.en: Measure the oscillator circuit supply and the oscillator output amplitude; an absent output means the module or its buffer has failed.
solutions.ur: Oscillator circuit ki supply aur oscillator output amplitude nikaalein; output na mile to module ya uska buffer kharab hai.

solutions.en: Replace the oscillator module or crystal matching the board's part number; do not substitute a random crystal.
solutions.ur: Board ke part number se milta jula oscillator module ya crystal badle dein; aik ghalat crystal istemaal na karein.

notes.en: On a 50 Hz site an output that will not sit at 50 Hz will show up as load-side timing faults.
notes.ur: 50 Hz site par agar output 50 Hz par tikay nahi rahta to load side par timing ke masle nazar aayenge.

source.title: Operation Manual - Smart-UPS C Uninterruptible Power Supply 1000/1500 VA Tower / Rack-Mount 2U, 120 Vac/230 Vac (part su0752c/su0752d)

meaning.en: Two measurement paths disagree, so the unit has shut down rather than run on a reading it does not trust.
meaning.ur: Do measurement raaste aapas mein match nahi kar rahe, is liye unit un par bharosa karke chalne ke bajaye band ho gaya.

causes.en: Redundant voltage/current sensors disagree because one has drifted or failed.
causes.ur: Do redundant voltage/current sensors mein se koi ek drift ya kharab ho gaya hai.

causes.en: Sensor or sense wiring harness connector loose, so the two channels read differently.
causes.ur: Sensor ya sense wiring harness ka connector loose hai, is liye dono channels alag readings de rahe hain.

causes.en: Calibration data lost after a factory reset or EEPROM event.
causes.ur: Factory reset ya EEPROM event ke baad calibration data kho gaya.

solutions.en: Isolate mains and battery, then measure input voltage, output voltage and load current independently with a meter.
solutions.ur: Mains aur battery isolate karein, phir input voltage, output voltage aur load current ko meter se alag alag nikaalein.

solutions.en: Compare both channels against the meter; the channel with the larger deviation is the failed one.
solutions.ur: Dono channels ko meter se compare karein; jis channel ka farq zyada ho wohi kharab hai.

solutions.en: Reseat all sensor harness connectors, clean the pin contacts, and re-tighten any loose earth at the sensor board.
solutions.ur: Har sensor harness connector dobara baitha dein, pin contacts saaf karein, aur sensor board par koi loose earth ho to kass lein.

solutions.en: If channels agree with a meter but not each other, run the calibration/factory setup from the manual.
solutions.ur: Agar channels meter se match karein magar aapas mein nahi, to manual ka calibration/factory setup chalayein.

notes.en: The unit choosing to stop on a measurement disagreement is correct behaviour - do not force it to run.
notes.ur: Measurement mismatch par unit ka rukna theek hai - use zabardasti chalane ki koshish na karein.

source.title: Operation Manual - Smart-UPS C Uninterruptible Power Supply 1000/1500 VA Tower / Rack-Mount 2U, 120 Vac/230 Vac (part su0752c/su0752d)

meaning.en: A functional block of the UPS has reported a fault to the controller and the unit has shut the output down.
meaning.ur: UPS ka koi aik functional block ne controller ko fault report kiya hai aur unit ne output band kar diya hai.

causes.en: A sub-assembly (inverter, charger, fan controller or bypass) has failed.
causes.ur: Koi sub-assembly (inverter, charger, fan controller ya bypass) kharab ho gaya hai.

causes.en: The subsystem's own self-test failed on start-up.
causes.ur: Subsystem ka apna self-test start-up par fail ho gaya.

causes.en: Subsystem supply or its interlock to the main board is faulty.
causes.ur: Subsystem ki supply ya main board se uska interlock kharab hai.

solutions.en: Isolate mains and battery before opening the unit, and photograph the board connections before disturbing anything.
solutions.ur: Unit kholne se pehle mains aur battery isolate karein, aur kuch bhi chhedne se pehle board connections ki tasveer lein.

solutions.en: Identify which subsystem raised the fault by reading the diagnostic/event log on the LCD after restart.
solutions.ur: LCD par diagnostic/event log parh kar pata karein ke kaunsa subsystem fault uthata hai.

solutions.en: Check that subsystem's own supply rail and interlock signal at the main board connector with a meter.
solutions.ur: Us subsystem ki apni supply rail aur interlock signal main board connector par meter se check karein.

solutions.en: Service or replace the failed sub-assembly; a generic 'subsystem' code only becomes specific once the board is probed.
solutions.ur: Kharab sub-assembly service ya badle dein; 'subsystem' code board probe ke baad hi specific hota hai.

notes.en: G.11 is a wrapper code - it tells you a subsystem failed, not which one. Expect to escalate this.
notes.ur: G.11 aik wrapper code hai - yeh batata hai ke subsystem kharab hua, keunsa nahi. Isay aage barhana hoga.

source.title: Operation Manual - Smart-UPS C Uninterruptible Power Supply 1000/1500 VA Tower / Rack-Mount 2U, 120 Vac/230 Vac (part su0752c/su0752d)

title.ur: Battery ki umar khatam hone wali hai (L.01)

meaning.en: The UPS has counted enough discharge cycles that the battery is near the end of its service life, so plan a replacement.
meaning.ur: UPS ne itne discharge cycles gin liye ke battery apni service life ke ant par hai, is liye badalne ki planning kar lein.

causes.en: Battery has reached its rated cycle count for the installed chemistry.
causes.ur: Battery apni installed chemistry ke rated cycle count tak pohanch gaya hai.

causes.en: High operating temperature has consumed the battery's float life faster.
causes.ur: Chalti hui battery ki float life high temperature ki wajah se jaldi khatam ho gayi.

causes.en: Frequent deep discharge from repeated long outages.
causes.ur: Baar baar lambi outages ki wajah se baar baar deep discharge hua.

solutions.en: The LCD alarm is acknowledged by pressing MUTE for 0.2 second; the warning clears but the underlying battery is still ageing.
solutions.ur: LCD alarm MUTE dabakar 0.2 second ke liye acknowledge hota hai; warning mit jata hai magar battery phir bhi purani ho rahi hai.

solutions.en: Measure the battery string DC voltage at float and run a self-test to see actual remaining capacity.
solutions.ur: Float par battery string ka DC voltage nikaalein aur self-test chalayein taake asli baaki capacity pata chale.

solutions.en: Book a replacement battery of the specified type and number, and schedule it before the next expected outage.
solutions.ur: Munasib battery type aur number ka replacement mangwayein, aur agli mutaabiya outage se pehle schedule kar lein.

notes.en: APC manual: 'If the LCD indicates battery LifeTime NearEnd or Exceeded, press the MUTE button for 0.2 second to acknowledge the alarm.'
notes.ur: APC manual: 'Agar LCD par battery LifeTime NearEnd ya Exceeded dikh raha ho to alarm acknowledge karne ke liye MUTE 0.2 second ke liye dabayein.'

source.title: Operation Manual - Smart-UPS C Uninterruptible Power Supply 1000/1500 VA Tower / Rack-Mount 2U, 120 Vac/230 Vac (part su0752c/su0752d)

meaning.en: The battery is past its end of service life, so the UPS is running without effective backup and the pack must be changed.
meaning.ur: Battery apni service life ke baad nikal chuki hai, is liye UPS bina effective backup ke chal raha hai aur pack badalna zaroori hai.

causes.en: Battery pack is older than its rated 3-5 year service life.
causes.ur: Battery pack apni 3-5 saal ki rated service life se ooper hai.

causes.en: Repeated high-temperature operation aged the cells far faster than calendar life suggests.
causes.ur: Baar baar high temperature par chalanay se cells calendar life se bohat zyada jaldi purani ho gayi.

causes.en: Deep discharge and partial discharges accumulated over years of load-shedding conditions.
causes.ur: Saalon ke load-shedding mein deep aur partial discharges jama ho gaye.

solutions.en: Acknowledge the LCD alarm with MUTE for 0.2 second so the unit stops beeping, then plan the replacement.
solutions.ur: LCD alarm ko MUTE 0.2 second ke liye dabakar acknowledge karein taake beeping band ho, phir replacement ki planning karein.

solutions.en: Power off, unplug mains, disconnect the old battery, then load-test or replace it - the unit has no real backup now.
solutions.ur: Power off karein, mains se nikaalein, purani battery disconnect karein, phir use load-test ya replace karein - abhi unit ka koi asli backup nahi.

solutions.en: Dispose of the old pack properly; lead-acid batteries are hazardous waste and must not be recharged or reused.
solutions.ur: Purane pack ko mehfooz tareeqe se fenk dein; lead-acid batteries hazardous waste hain, dobara charge ya istemaal na karein.

notes.en: L.02 means the customer is effectively running unprotected during outages until the pack is replaced.
notes.ur: L.02 ka matlab hai ke pack badle tak customer outages mein bilkul unprotected chal raha hai.

source.title: Operation Manual - Smart-UPS C Uninterruptible Power Supply 1000/1500 VA Tower / Rack-Mount 2U, 120 Vac/230 Vac (part su0752c/su0752d)

meaning.en: The SmartConnect network card has no Ethernet link, so cloud monitoring is unavailable.
meaning.ur: SmartConnect network card ka Ethernet link nahi hai, is liye cloud monitoring mojood nahi.

causes.en: Ethernet cable not plugged into the SmartConnect port, or a different port used.
causes.ur: Ethernet cable SmartConnect port mein plug nahi, ya koi doosra port use kiya gaya hai.

causes.en: Switch or router port down, or the cable damaged.
causes.ur: Switch ya router ka port down hai, ya cable damaged hai.

solutions.en: Check the network switch/router port LED; it must be lit and flickering with traffic.
solutions.ur: Network switch/router ke port ka LED dekhein; yeh chala hua aur traffic ke saath flicker karna chahiye.

solutions.en: Confirm the cable is in the SmartConnect port on the UPS, not a UPS management passthrough port.
solutions.ur: Confirm karein ke cable UPS ke SmartConnect port mein hai, kisi passthrough port mein nahi.

solutions.en: Test the cable with another known-good cable or on another port to rule out the cable itself.
solutions.ur: Cable ko aik ache se chalne wale cable ya doosre port par test karein taake cable khud confirm ho jaye.

notes.en: Communication state, not a power fault. The UPS protects the load normally while showing this.
notes.ur: Yeh communication state hai, power fault nahi. Ise aate hue bhi UPS load ko normal protect karta hai.

source.title: Operation Manual - Smart-UPS C Uninterruptible Power Supply 1000/1500 VA Tower / Rack-Mount 2U, 120 Vac/230 Vac (part su0752c/su0752d)

meaning.en: The SmartConnect card has opened its session with the cloud service; monitoring is live.
meaning.ur: SmartConnect card ne cloud service se apna session khol liya hai; monitoring chalu hai.

causes.en: Normal successful network registration with the SmartConnect cloud service.
causes.ur: SmartConnect cloud service ke saath normal aur kamyab network registration.

solutions.en: No action needed; log into the SmartConnect portal to confirm the UPS is reporting.
solutions.ur: Koi karakari zaroori nahi; SmartConnect portal mein login karke confirm karein ke UPS report kar raha hai.

solutions.en: For security, change the default portal credentials and enable a strong password on first login.
solutions.ur: Security ke liye pehli login par default portal credentials badal dein aur mazboot password lagayein.

notes.en: This is a healthy status. The 'See Manual' icon is hidden in all Sc.x states per the manual.
notes.ur: Yeh sehat status hai. Manual ke mutabiq tamam Sc.x states mein 'See Manual' icon chhupa hota hai.

source.title: Operation Manual - Smart-UPS C Uninterruptible Power Supply 1000/1500 VA Tower / Rack-Mount 2U, 120 Vac/230 Vac (part su0752c/su0752d)

meaning.en: The SmartConnect card is obtaining its local address via DHCP, so it is still starting up.
meaning.ur: SmartConnect card DHCP se apna local address le raha hai, is liye abhi startup chal raha hai.

causes.en: Normal DHCP lease in progress on the local network.
causes.ur: Local network par normal DHCP lease chal raha hai.

causes.en: DHCP server unreachable because the card is on a different VLAN or a different building.
causes.ur: DHCP server tak nahi pohanch raha kyunke card doosre VLAN ya doosri building mein hai.

solutions.en: Wait a couple of minutes for the lease; the state clears on its own once an address is assigned.
solutions.ur: Lease ke liye do minute intezaar karein; address milte hi yeh khud clear ho jata hai.

solutions.en: If it stays on Sc.2, check the site router's DHCP pool has not been exhausted and that VLAN routing is permitted.
solutions.ur: Agar Sc.2 par atka rahe to check karein ke site router ka DHCP pool khaali nahi hua aur VLAN routing ijazat hai.

solutions.en: Reserve a static address for the card in the router using its MAC to avoid DHCP dependence.
solutions.ur: Card ke MAC se router mein static address reserve kar dein taake DHCP par depend na ho.

notes.en: Transient state; a UPS stuck here is a network configuration issue, not a UPS fault.
notes.ur: Yehi guzarta hua state hai; yahan atka hua UPS network configuration ki masla hai, UPS ki kharabi nahi.

source.title: Operation Manual - Smart-UPS C Uninterruptible Power Supply 1000/1500 VA Tower / Rack-Mount 2U, 120 Vac/230 Vac (part su0752c/su0752d)

title.ur: SmartConnect: DNS resolve ho raha hai (Sc.3)

meaning.en: The card is resolving the cloud service name via DNS, so internet access is being established.
meaning.ur: Card DNS se cloud service ka naam resolve kar raha hai, is liye internet access ban raha hai.

causes.en: Normal DNS lookup in progress.
causes.ur: Normal DNS lookup chal raha hai.

causes.en: Site DNS server or internet link down, or the card has no route to the internet.
causes.ur: Site ka DNS server ya internet link down hai, ya card tak internet ka route nahi.

solutions.en: Test DNS from a laptop on the same network: resolve the SmartConnect hostname; an answer means DNS is fine.
solutions.ur: Usi network par laptop se DNS test karein: SmartConnect hostname resolve karein; jawab aa jaye to DNS theek hai.

solutions.en: Check the site internet link and router WAN status light before touching the UPS.
solutions.ur: UPS chhoone se pehle site ka internet link aur router ka WAN status light check karein.

solutions.en: If the site is behind a captive portal or blocks outbound traffic, allow the SmartConnect service through the firewall.
solutions.ur: Agar site captive portal ke peeche hai ya outbound traffic rokta hai to firewall se SmartConnect service ko ijazat dein.

notes.en: Common in Pakistani sites using a shared or filtered uplink; the fix is on the network, not the UPS.
notes.ur: Pakistan mein shared ya filtered uplink par aam masla hai; hal network mein hai, UPS mein nahi.

source.title: Operation Manual - Smart-UPS C Uninterruptible Power Supply 1000/1500 VA Tower / Rack-Mount 2U, 120 Vac/230 Vac (part su0752c/su0752d)

meaning.en: DNS resolution failed, so the card cannot contract with the cloud service.
meaning.ur: DNS resolve nahi hua, is liye card cloud service se contract nahi kar sakta.

causes.en: Site DNS server down or not reachable from the UPS VLAN.
causes.ur: Site ka DNS server down hai ya UPS VLAN se pohanchable nahi.

causes.en: Router/firewall blocking outbound DNS (UDP 53) or blocking the service domains.
causes.ur: Router/firewall outbound DNS (UDP 53) ya service domains block kar raha hai.

causes.en: Wrong or manually entered DNS addresses on the network.
causes.ur: Network par galat ya manually daale gaye DNS addresses hain.

solutions.en: From a PC on the same network, test name resolution; if it fails, the fault is upstream of the UPS.
solutions.ur: Usi network par PC se name resolution test karein; fail ho to fault UPS se pehle hai.

solutions.en: Set the router's DNS to a known-working resolver and confirm the UPS VLAN inherits it.
solutions.ur: Router ka DNS kisi confirmed chal raha resolver par set karein aur confirm karein ke UPS VLAN use hi leta hai.

solutions.en: Allow outbound DNS and HTTPS from the UPS subnet on the firewall.
solutions.ur: Firewall par UPS subnet se outbound DNS aur HTTPS ki ijazat dein.

solutions.en: Power-cycle the network card so it retries the whole addressing and DNS sequence.
solutions.ur: Network card ko power-cycle karein taake wo poora addressing aur DNS sequence dobara try kare.

notes.en: No UPS hardware fault is implied by Sc.4 - check the network path before condemning the card.
notes.ur: Sc.4 ka matlab UPS hardware kharab nahi - card kharab kehne se pehle network raasta check karein.

source.title: Operation Manual - Smart-UPS C Uninterruptible Power Supply 1000/1500 VA Tower / Rack-Mount 2U, 120 Vac/230 Vac (part su0752c/su0752d)

title.ur: SmartConnect: TLS secure ho raha hai (Sc.5)

meaning.en: The Transport Layer Security handshake with the cloud service is in progress.
meaning.ur: Cloud service ke saath Transport Layer Security handshake chal raha hai.

causes.en: Normal TLS session establishment in progress.
causes.ur: Normal TLS session establish ho raha hai.

causes.en: System clock badly wrong so the certificate validity check stalls or fails.
causes.ur: System clock bohat ghalat hai is liye certificate validity check ruk gaya ya fail hua.

solutions.en: Let the handshake finish; it normally takes a few seconds on a good link.
solutions.ur: Handshake mukammal hone dein; ache uplink par yeh chand secondon mein hota hai.

solutions.en: If it hangs, check the UPS date/time setting is correct and, if the site uses NTP, that NTP is reachable.
solutions.ur: Agar atak jaye to check karein ke UPS ki date/time setting theek hai, aur site NTP istemaal karti ho to NTP pohanchable hai.

solutions.en: Verify the site router date is correct as well, since TLS validation depends on it.
solutions.ur: Site router ki date bhi check karein kyunke TLS validation us par depend karta hai.

notes.en: Clock accuracy matters more than it looks - a wrong date is a common cause of stuck cloud connections.
notes.ur: Date ki sahi lagah cheezon se zyada ahem hai - ghalat date cloud connection atakne ki aam wajah hai.

source.title: Operation Manual - Smart-UPS C Uninterruptible Power Supply 1000/1500 VA Tower / Rack-Mount 2U, 120 Vac/230 Vac (part su0752c/su0752d)

title.ur: SmartConnect: cloud se connect ho raha hai (Sc.6)

meaning.en: The application link with the cloud is being established, so the card is mid-registration.
meaning.ur: Cloud se application link banaaya ja raha hai, is liye card registration ke darmiyan hai.

causes.en: Normal cloud registration in progress.
causes.ur: Normal cloud registration chal raha hai.

causes.en: Slow or heavily filtered uplink extending the registration time.
causes.ur: Slow ya zyada filtered uplink ki wajah se registration ka waqt barh raha hai.

solutions.en: Allow the registration to finish before power-cycling; interrupting it restarts the whole sequence.
solutions.ur: Power-cycle karne se pehle registration mukammal hone dein; beech mein rokna poora sequence dobara shuru karta hai.

solutions.en: If it never completes, test HTTPS reachability to the service from a PC on the same subnet.
solutions.ur: Agar mukammal na ho to usi subnet ke PC se service ki HTTPS reachability test karein.

solutions.en: Check that the site firewall allows outbound HTTPS and does not do TLS inspection on the UPS traffic.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke site firewall outbound HTTPS ki ijazat deta hai aur UPS traffic par TLS inspection nahi karta.

notes.en: Some Pakistani corporate firewalls do TLS inspection, which breaks certificate validation for the card.
notes.ur: Kuch Pakistani corporate firewalls TLS inspection karte hain, jisse card ka certificate validation toot jata hai.

source.title: Operation Manual - Smart-UPS C Uninterruptible Power Supply 1000/1500 VA Tower / Rack-Mount 2U, 120 Vac/230 Vac (part su0752c/su0752d)

meaning.en: Cloud monitoring is switched off because a wombat card is inserted for embedded systems, or a configuration has disabled it.
meaning.ur: Cloud monitoring band hai kyunke embedded systems ke liye wombat card laga hai, ya kisi configuration ne isay band kar diya hai.

causes.en: A wombat card is inserted for an embedded system, which disables the cloud link by design.
causes.ur: Embedded system ke liye wombat card laga hai, jis se design ke mutabiq cloud link band ho jata hai.

causes.en: SmartConnect has been deliberately disabled in the configuration.
causes.ur: Configuration mein SmartConnect jaan boojh kar band kar diya gaya hai.

solutions.en: Confirm with the site owner whether cloud monitoring is wanted; if yes, re-enable SmartConnect in the configuration.
solutions.ur: Site ke maalik se poochein ke cloud monitoring chahiye ya nahi; chahiye to configuration mein SmartConnect dobara on karein.

solutions.en: If a wombat card is fitted for an embedded application, leave SmartConnect off - that is the intended behaviour.
solutions.ur: Agar embedded application ke liye wombat card laga hai to SmartConnect off hi rakhein - yeh hi mansooba hua amal hai.

notes.en: Not a fault. The UPS continues to protect the load; only remote reporting is unavailable.
notes.ur: Yeh fault nahi. UPS load ko protect karta rehta hai; sirf door ki reporting nahi milti.

source.title: Operation Manual - Smart-UPS C Uninterruptible Power Supply 1000/1500 VA Tower / Rack-Mount 2U, 120 Vac/230 Vac (part su0752c/su0752d)

title.en: SmartConnect Prohibited - Unit in Factory Mode (Sc.8)
title.ur: SmartConnect prohibited, unit factory mode mein (Sc.8)

meaning.en: The card cannot reach the cloud because the unit is still in factory mode, or EEPROM, MAC or PHY hardware has failed.
meaning.ur: Card cloud tak nahi pohanch sakta kyunke unit abhi factory mode mein hai, ya EEPROM, MAC ya PHY hardware kharab ho gaya hai.

causes.en: Unit is still in factory mode and has not completed G.06 factory setup.
causes.ur: Unit abhi factory mode mein hai aur G.06 factory setup mukammal nahi hua.

causes.en: EEPROM on the SmartConnect card has failed, so no identity can be read.
causes.ur: SmartConnect card ka EEPROM kharab ho gaya hai, is liye koi identity parhi nahi ja sakti.

causes.en: MAC address or PHY (Ethernet physical layer) hardware failure detected.
causes.ur: MAC address ya PHY (Ethernet physical layer) hardware kharabi detect hui hai.

solutions.en: Complete the factory setup on the unit first; Sc.8 is expected until G.06 is cleared.
solutions.ur: Pehle unit par factory setup mukammal karein; G.06 mitne tak Sc.8 aana normal hai.

solutions.en: Power off, unplug mains, disconnect the battery, then reseat the SmartConnect card in its slot firmly.
solutions.ur: Power off karein, mains se nikaalein, battery disconnect karein, phir SmartConnect card ko apni slot mein mazbooti se baitha dein.

solutions.en: Check the card's MAC address label against the one reported in the network, and confirm only one card is fitted.
solutions.ur: Card ke MAC address label ko network mein report hone wale se compare karein, aur confirm karein ke aik hi card laga hai.

solutions.en: If EEPROM/MAC/PHY hardware is genuinely failed, replace the SmartConnect card; the UPS itself still works.
solutions.ur: Agar EEPROM/MAC/PAY hardware asal mein kharab hai to SmartConnect card badal dein; UPS khud chalta rehta hai.

notes.en: Do not discard the UPS for this code - only the network card is implicated.
notes.ur: Is code ki wajah se UPS phenk dein mat - sirf network card mutasir hai.

source.title: Operation Manual - Smart-UPS C Uninterruptible Power Supply 1000/1500 VA Tower / Rack-Mount 2U, 120 Vac/230 Vac (part su0752c/su0752d)
